verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform documents an API for listing deployments, findings and projects, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The Semgrep Editor is a rule-writing playground, an adjacent feature that does not count as an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
